given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator is viewing the version history of an active Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.when: The Platform Operator selects a previous version to compare against the current active version
given_when_then.then: A side-by-side comparison view displays only the fields and values that have changed between the two versions.

given_when_then.given: An amendment to a Store Partner Agreement is initiated by the Platform Operator
given_when_then.when: The amendment is saved and processed by the system
given_when_then.then: A new version number is assigned to the agreement, the previous version is marked as historical, and the new version is marked as active.

given_when_then.given: The system contains multiple historical and active versions of a Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.when: The Platform Operator requests the version history view
given_when_then.then: The view lists all existing versions in chronological order with their version numbers and status indicators.

given_when_then.given: A Store Partner attempts to access the edit interface for an agreement version
given_when_then.when: The Store Partner is not the owner of the agreement and the Platform Operator has not granted explicit permission
given_when_then.then: The system restricts access and prevents the Store Partner from editing the agreement version.

success_criteria: The system successfully creates a new version number for the Store Partner Agreement upon amendment without deleting the previous version.
The version history view correctly displays a comparison of changes between selected agreement versions.
The system correctly marks the previous version as historical immediately after an amendment is applied.
The system prevents deletion of any agreement version once it has been created.
